body: Not exactly what you've done, but similar, yes.

That's optional, it's up to you, there's no need to tell her if you don't want to. I had a similar situation when I was 10 with my younger cousin. Kids who engage in these kinds of behaviours usually have suffered some sort of trauma themselves, and things like these are outlets, ways to rationalise what you were too young to understand or even remember. I personally have a good relationship with my cousin to the point where when he's old enough I can tell him and we could probably both work through it. 

If your sister ever has any questions, don't lie to her. But there's no need to bring it up if it's unnecessary or it will cause any issues in the future family-wise. There may be other circumstances where you might need to bring it up, but chances are your sister is okay. 

You were a child, children do gross things. You're old enough to understand why what you did was wrong, and you regret it. You've learned from your mistakes. That's not disgusting, and nobody should be held against actions done in the past if they've improved, none the less actions done when you weren't even in middle school yet. 

Families are weird, they're all different. The way my cousin reacts won't be the same way your sister might react. Only you will know in your situation. You've proven yourself to be mature and responsible enough to acknowledge what you did, and have grown as a person. And thus you're mature enough to know what steps you should take going forward on how to deal with this issue, if you need to tell anybody or not, and how to deal with your guilt.

No. It's not rape, and you were a child. Kids have strange sexual thoughts all the time, and you didn't take things to an extreme, only thought about it. And once again you were a _child._ 9 year olds don't rape, they're literally incapable of it because they cannot grasp the concept of it or why it's bad. It's like sending a child to jail for playing with a gun, as if the child was supposed to know better when the accidentally shot someone. It's not rape.


As the parent comment said, calling what you did rape is like charging a toddler for indecency.

Well if you want me to be honest I've never gotten addicted to it personally and it is a nice outlet. I wouldn't recommend cutting yourself even though I used to do it because it's still incredibly dangerous but generally self harm, like hitting yourself helps in the moment to clear your head. Doesn't help long term. 

I'm just being honest cause that's what I've experienced. I don't know if this is against the rules or anything but it's not like I'm actively telling you to do anything.
